summary: iter-455 Clinical Diagnosis — frontend-only test. All 7 scenarios (T1–T7) passed on mobile viewport 390x844. Phase 1 Step 2 renders the clinical-diagnosis-card above Submit for Approval; verdict 'Overall: Modify plan' with chip counts 2/1/3 (high/modify/favourable); required chips dx-chip-S-PHN (red: Thin, High scalloped), dx-chip-S-SML (red: High), dx-chip-M-RDG (amber: 11 Horizontal), dx-chip-S-MD (green: 11 8 mm) all present. 'Not assessed in Phase 1' block visible with ASA/plaque/periodontitis/bruxism/buccal plate/soft-tissue/keratinised items. dx-text-input begins with 'CLINICAL DIAGNOSIS — PHASE 1' and contains NO literature-reference tokens (ITI/SAC/Tarnow/Elian/Aparicio verified absent). T2 edit (append + dx-save-btn) persists through reload; header tag reads 'Edited by Dr. Gaurav Pandey'. T3 regenerate via POST /api/procedures/{id}/diagnosis/generate?force=true (web Alert confirm not triggered — expected RN-web behaviour) wipes clinician text and resets edited_at. T4 dx-toggle-findings hides (6→0 chips) and re-shows them. T5 admin (Abhijit.patil) on /procedures/{id}: dx-section + dx-text-readonly + dx-edit-btn visible; edit flow writes back and shows 'Edited by Dr. Abhijit Patil'; restored via force-regen. T6 Gaurav case-detail renders without crash on a non-owned phase1_approved case; edit button present (consistent with his assistant role on that case). T7 regression: PredictiveRiskCard (Historical Outcome Nudge) and Implant Planning section both remain above the diagnosis card; Submit for Approval button rendered at bottom (not pressed). Draft 6ab7f3ab84f8a4c56eb61fb0 status remains 'draft'; both clinician edits (student + admin) were cleared/restored via force regenerate.
critical_code_review_comments: ClinicalDiagnosisCard.tsx: on mount with existing initial.text, it fires generate(false) automatically to refresh findings while keeping clinician text. If a case has stale server-side generated_text, this is correct, but it causes an extra API round-trip every time the card mounts; consider gating by generated_at age.
GET /api/procedures listing returns created_by/creator_id as null (not populated), making client-side ownership checks impossible — minor API hygiene concern (unrelated to iter-455).

RN-web: regenerate confirm Alert.alert with buttons is a no-op on web (silently resolves to default). Consider swapping to window.confirm or a custom modal on web so the destructive-replace step is actually gated for web users.
